Adverbial clauses of time with when / be: A time adverbial clause introduced by when/before/after/as soon as; the future is expressed with the present.本课为典型例句练习,核心:The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。
when + point in time|before = before, after = after|main clause future, subordinate clause present|as soon as = as soon as|while + continuous action
